EC1: The following conditions will not be considered as outcome, unless they present with
EC2: systemic repercussion due to infection. For example:
EC5: - Fungal infections of the skin (athlete's foot, [OR] jockitch, [OR] ringworm, and yeast infections)
EC10: - Sexually transmitted infections (Gonorrhoea, [OR] Syphilis, [OR] Trichomonas, [OR] Chlamydia, [OR] Hepatitis, [OR] HIV)
EC12: - Bacterial colonization (presence of microorganisms [NOT] without clinical signs/symptoms)
EC13: - Known vaginal, [OR] urethral [OR] and/or rectal GBS colonization
EC16: - Non-infectious hypothermia/ [OR] hyperthermia (e.g. related to epidural, [OR] thyroid storm, [OR] prostaglandin administration) during hospital stay
